title: Every Spend Is Under Scrutiny: Restaurant Occasions in 2026
discussion_signal: The discussion describes a K-shaped consumption pattern: functional restaurant occasions are traded toward cheaper grocery or beverage channels, while emotionally satisfying or ritual occasions survive when they feel worth the price. It adds a lived-value mechanism beneath the atlas record's affordability and occasion segmentation.
linked_research_question: How do households under pressure distinguish replaceable food spending from social, ritual, or emotionally valuable occasions?
limits: The discussion is not a representative household sample
Occasion claims are interpretive rather than causal
Public search discovery is not a platform-native Creator/API export
